text: The night bends, soft and slow
A cradle made of skies
The river holds the peace
Floating by your side
The moon will guard your sleep,
With silver in its eyes
The river knows your name
Whispers as you drift by
A fragile thing to brave the water
The dawn will meet it there with honor
My little paper boat, don't be afraid
No wave can turn the course you sail
The stars above, they linger and guide you on your way
I'll hold you close through the tide and bring you home today
The night has weighed on you,
The shadows left their mark
I know the streams you've crossed,
Within the dark
The storm will press its hand and try to drag you down,
But still your light is found
I know you will shine it out
Be safe and sound
A fragile thing to brave the water
The dawn will meet it there with honor
My little paper boat, don't be afraid
No wave can turn the course you sail
The stars above, they linger and guide you on your way
I'll hold you close through the tide and bring you home today
Now that harbor lights are near,
Your journey's coming to rest
Safe at home from where you came,
You've always been your very best
